category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting inappropriate social behaviors like yelling and taking toys
scenario_title: Managing peer interactions and transitions during preschool routines
minimal_context: Gregory is participating in free play time in the preschool classroom and needs to interact appropriately with his peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for free play in the classroom. Please find a toy to play with.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes a toy from another child) I want this one!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's do a brief rehearsal of our classroom rules.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hides the toy behind his back) No!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to practice listening to others and being a team player.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells at the other child and starts crying) Go away!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for free play in the classroom. Please find a toy to play with.

STUDENT: (Takes a toy from another child) I want this one!

TUTOR: Let's do a brief rehearsal of our classroom rules.

STUDENT: (Hides the toy behind his back) No!

TUTOR: We need to practice listening to others and being a team player.

STUDENT: (Yells at the other child and starts crying) Go away!

task.content: General classroom interaction and daily classroom routines
task.learning_goal: Listening to others, being a team player, and engaging in more rule-following behaviors

context.environment: Preschool classroom at Edgewood Pines Early Childhood Center and the director's office
context.materials: Toys, visual schedules, rules posters, teaching matrix, timer, Thumbs Up sheet, choice board
context.social_setting: Interacting with other children, preschool teachers Mr. Hughes and Ms. Valencia, and center director Ms. W
context.time_context: Throughout the school day, including morning check-in, transitions between routines, and end-of-day check-out

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During daily classroom routines, even with the universal supports in place
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Engages in inappropriate social behaviors, such as yelling at other children, taking their toys, hiding toys and other children's belongings, and crying

behavior_patterns.condition: Following each instance of misbehavior when teachers try to do brief rehearsals of the classroom rules
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Continues to have an average of 23 instances of misbehavior per day
